SELECT m.name AS model_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mt.resolved_on IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(mt.cost, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike b2 WHERE b2.model_id = m.model_id), 2) AS cost_per_bike
FROM model m
JOIN bike b ON b.model_id = m.model_id
JOIN maintenance mt ON mt.bike_id = b.bike_id
GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name
ORDER BY cost_per_bike DESC
LIMIT 1;
